_comment: Source: https://api.lever.co/v0/postings/sonarsource?mode=json — captured 2026-08-25. JSON has no comment syntax and Lever answers with a bare array, so this header rides on a first element that parseBoard drops for having no id/text/hostedUrl. CUT: descriptionPlain, additionalPlain, openingPlain, descriptionBody(-Plain), applyUrl, workplaceType, and most of each description. KEPT VERBATIM: id, text, hostedUrl, createdAt, categories, country, and the four-part description/lists/additional split. ADVERSARIAL CASES, in order: (1) a Geneva posting whose body is split across description + two lists + additional, so a parser reading only `description` loses the requirements; (2) a posting Swiss only via categories.allLocations, which must be KEPT — allLocations are the job's places, not the company's offices; (3) a London posting with no Swiss location anywhere, excluded; (4) a Zurich posting with no createdAt, so postedAt must be null rather than guessed; (5) a Swiss posting with no hostedUrl, skipped without throwing.

description: Who is Sonar? We build code quality tooling used by millions of developers.

lists.content:
• Own the ABM programme end to end.
  • Partner with sales on target accounts.

• 5+ years in B2B marketing.
  • Fluent English; French a plus.

description: Swiss only via allLocations. A role open in London and Zurich is a Zurich role.
No Swiss location anywhere. Must be excluded.
No createdAt on this one, so postedAt is null rather than invented.
Swiss, but no hostedUrl — nothing to store or dedupe on, so it is skipped.
